notes: kb/Work PB5925 (listing step 4b of docs/rearchitecture/DESIGN-listing.md, 2026-11-18), judged by the 2002 text. The compiler produces a source listing on request at --std 2002 (cobol --listing; DOC-A.1-117, B.1 item 90), so §2002:7.2.15.2 GR1's "Otherwise, the following general rules apply" holds and the row is decided by the listing. GR2: "The default LISTING directive is '>>LISTING ON'." The driver's LISTING state starts ON (ConditionalCompilationProcessor.Run._listingOn) and so does the visibility pass; the witness lists every line before its first LISTING OFF.
